topic: 5 Google Ads mistakes Indian e-commerce brands make before even writing a single ad
hook: 5 Google Ads mistakes killing your e-commerce budget
caption:
Most Indian e-commerce brands blame Google Ads for poor results. The real problem usually shows up before the first ad is even written.

I have audited accounts spending anywhere from ₹15,000 to ₹5 lakh a month, and the same foundational mistakes appear every single time — broken conversion tracking, wafer-thin budgets, homepage landing pages, and feeds nobody has touched since the store launched.

These are not beginner errors. Even brands running ads for two or three years make them because nobody sat down and fixed the structure at the start.

This carousel covers the five mistakes I see most often — and the ones that are easiest to fix before you spend another rupee.

Which one have you encountered in your own campaigns?
